embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:930fea6.title: AI Research Scientist
embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:930fea6.description: Why RoboForce RoboForce is an AI robotics company developing Physical AI–powered Robo-Labor for dull, dirty, and dangerous work. The company's robots are engineered for demanding industrial environments, with a focus on real-world deployment and scalability. We are looking for a Senior / Staff AI Research Scientist, Foundation Models to advance robotic embodied intelligence. In this role, you will develop algorithms that enable robots to understand their environment, interpret and execute tasks, and communicate seamlessly with humans — with a particular focus on building and training world models that allow robots to predict, plan, and generalize across complex physical tasks. Responsibilities • Design and deploy vision-language(-action) models (VLM/VLA) for contextual understanding and generalized robot action policies. • Develop and train world models for action-conditioned prediction, long-horizon planning, and environment simulation — enabling robots to reason about the consequences of their actions before execution. • Research approaches to improve world model fidelity using multi-modal inputs including vision, language, proprioception, and spatial representations. • Develop foundation models with spatial reasoning capabilities to achieve high-precision robotic actions. • Integrate multi-modal data sources (vision, language, speech, etc.) to enable natural human-robot communication. • Optimize and deploy models as production-grade solutions on RoboForce robotic platforms. Requirements • PhD degree in Machine Learning, Robotics, or related field, or Master's degree with 4+ years of relevant experience. • Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, JAX). • Expertise in large foundation models (VLM, VLA, etc.). • Strong understanding of world model architectures and action-conditioned generative modeling for robot learning. • Decent understanding of multimodal models, modern ML architectures (transformers, diffusion models, etc.). • Requires 5 days/week in-office collaboration with the teams. Bonus Qualifications • Experience with video generation or prediction models (e.g., diffusion-based video models, autoregressive video transformers) and their application to world modeling or synthetic data generation for robot learning. • Strong publication record at top conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ICCV, CoRL, ICRA, or equivalent). • Expertise in neural network deployment (e.g., TensorRT) and GPU programming with CUDA. • Proven ability to design scalable experimentation and data pipelines. Benefits • Competitive stock options/equity programs. • Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) plan. • Visa sponsorship and green card support for qualified candidates. • Lunches and dinners, a fully stocked kitchen, and regular team-building events.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7a7720e4-4eef-.title: Onboarding Success Manager I
jobgether-jobgether:lever:7a7720e4-4eef-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Onboarding Success Manager I based in France. As an Onboarding Success Manager, you will be at the forefront of the customer and team member experience during the onboarding journey. You will guide customers and their new hires from the initial onboarding request through successful engagement, ensuring every step is clear, accurate, and efficient. Working across Legal, Sales, Product, Finance, and Operations, you will resolve complex requests and escalations while keeping the customer experience at the center. You will combine strong communication and organizational skills with careful data management and an ability to navigate evolving processes and regulations. The role offers significant autonomy within a globally distributed, remote-first environment built around asynchronous collaboration. You will also contribute to improving documentation, self-service resources, workflows, and operational processes to make onboarding increasingly seamless. This is an opportunity to help shape the future of global employment while supporting customers and talent across multiple countries. Own the end-to-end onboarding journey for Customers and Team Members, acting as the primary point of contact from the submission of a new hire through their successful engagement. Provide timely, accurate, and customer-friendly guidance through explanatory documentation, internal knowledge sources, and direct communication. Organize and lead meetings with Customers and Team Members to answer questions, clarify requirements, and keep onboarding activities moving forward. Manage custom requests and escalations, working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Legal, Finance, and other internal teams to reach effective resolutions. Support contract customization activities in accordance with established internal procedures, requirements, and timelines. Ensure all required customer information is collected, processed, and recorded accurately. Maintain complete and accurate data within the employment platform to support smooth employment and a seamless customer experience. Follow established playbooks, processes, and best practices while identifying opportunities to improve operational consistency and efficiency. Create, maintain, and improve customer-facing and internal documentation explaining onboarding processes and requirements. Contribute to customer self-service tools and internal knowledge resources, helping customers resolve common questions independently. Monitor product releases and changes in global employment regulations to ensure onboarding guidance remains accurate and relevant. Track and work toward agreed customer experience and operational KPIs, including satisfaction-related metrics. Complete ongoing training and upskilling to maintain strong product, process, and global employment knowledge. Identify workflow and automation opportunities, including practical applications of AI, to improve productivity, customer experience, and operational excellence. Requirements 3+ years of experience in HR or in a customer-facing role within an HR SaaS or comparable technology environment. Strong customer-first mindset, with a genuine commitment to understanding customer needs and going beyond expectations to provide excellent support. Proven experience scheduling and managing customer meetings and maintaining productive customer relationships. Experience managing customer escalations and coordinating effectively with multiple internal stakeholders to resolve complex issues. Demonstrated ability to meet and improve customer satisfaction metrics such as CSAT or NPS. Experience following, maintaining, and improving operational processes to deliver a consistent customer experience while knowing when a personalized human approach is needed. Excellent attention to detail, organization, analytical thinking, and time-management ski

responsibilities: Partner with Hinge's product, design, and engineering teams as an embedded legal advisor throughout the full product lifecycle, from ideation and design through launch and commercialization, providing practical, solution-oriented counsel that keeps momentum without sacrificing rigor.
Help manage the intake, triage, and prioritization of day-to-day legal questions and requests from business stakeholders, ensuring timely routing, response, and escalation as needed.
Develop a deep understanding of Hinge's product, technology, and data practices to deliver proactive, business-minded advice on new features, AI-driven functionality, and safety initiatives.

Serve as legal liaison to product and design teams on compliance with domestic and international laws governing consumer-facing technology, including advertising, intellectual property and consumer protection.

Partner closely with Hinge Privacy counsel and cross-functional Privacy teams on data protection, privacy-by-design reviews, and regulatory compliance matters affecting product features, data practices, and new market launches.

Collaborate with Match Group’s Litigation, Trust & Safety, Corporate Affairs and other shared-services teams to gather information and implement changes in response to regulatory inquiries, litigation, or company-wide initiatives

Partner with Hinge and our broader Match Group Legal team to evolve Hinge's user-facing legal policies and disclosures, including Terms of Use, content and community guidelines, and consumer-facing messaging.

Develop, advise and manage continuous improvement of cross-functional legal workflows, including playbooks, training, templates, and AI-assisted processes, to reduce time-to-answer on recurring legal questions and scale support as Hinge grows.
Issue-spot and assess legal and regulatory risk for new and evolving products,  particularly AI systems, under emerging AI regulation globally (e.g., the EU AI Act) and at the U.S. state level.

Draft and negotiate a range of commercial agreements supporting product development, including technology licensing, SaaS, data/analytics, research, and vendor agreements, partnering with Hinge Commercial Legal and relevant stakeholders where appropriate.
Guide product launches into new markets, ensuring compliance with local legal requirements and coordinating with local internal and external counsel as needed.
Conduct legal research on novel issues affecting Hinge’s products and users.

Act as a trusted, embedded legal partner who identifies jurisdiction-specific risk early, builds scalable compliance frameworks, and finds creative paths forward that keep ambitious product bets moving.

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.title: Supervisor
summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek a skilled supervisor to drive results. This individual will need to be the gold standard in all our processes, so attention to detail and high drive to win is a must. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You will manage a team of highly trained, optimistic Advisors, Operators, and Attendants to provide exceptional guest service in a fun, interactive atmosphere. We need a dedicated team member that has experience in a supervisory role, and a willingness to learn the car wash industry. Location: Russell Speeders Car Wash (Omaha 9) 6003 Center Street, Omaha, NE 68106
